symptom: Activated client handles on a real development VM copied the remaining source-cache lifetime and expired after 1.8 or 2.6 seconds, before the worker's first 10-second renewal. File and Git operations lost their carrier despite valid personal access.
rule: Require usable authority at every context issuance, material delivery and renewal boundary. Reverify a short source observation instead of moving its deadline, retain stable live material retries, and fail transactionally if final checks consume the budget (zstack-review time and authority checks).
